messages:
mike: heads-up: onboarding Nyx-7B (llama-variant with fractional-rotary and legacy adapters). Ran int4 awq export and got reproducible tokenization + phase drift on ligature/emoji sequences. minimal repro and tiny logs below. anyone seen ligature/zwj + quant oddities? :eyes:

mike: repro:
python export.py --model nyx-7b --dtype fp16 --out nyx_fp16.onnx
python quantize_awq.py --in nyx_fp16.onnx --out nyx_int4.onnx --opt axis_swap
python sample.py --model nyx_int4.onnx --prompt "man‍❤️" --log-tokens

mike: logs (sanitized):
# fp16 ids: [5, 9876, 4]
# int4 ids: [5, 4532, 4]
# first-embed cos_sim: 0.999 -> 0.84

raj: axis_swap/permute again. does nyx have hetero head dims or fractional freq? if so global reshape will break offsets.

mike: yes hybrid heads (64/48 mix) and rotary freq_scale=0.8 baked in. exporter emits implicit freq calc currently.

sara: tokenizer angle: ligatures and ZWJ joins often rely on NFKC/NFC handling. our byte-level pretokenizer in the quant path has a microshim that differs from the fp16 stack. small embedding offset shifts can flip token boundary for multi-codepoint glyphs.

jen: quick isolation test: quantize with --no-axis-swap -> token ids match fp16 for many cases but cos_sim still decays a bit. so two issues: (1) axis_swap can cause token boundary changes, (2) quant rounding + implicit freq recompute -> rotary phase drift.

raj: plan: 1) change quantizer to emit per-head reshape+transpose when head_dims non-uniform. 2) exporter: materialize rotary_freq as initializer when freq_scale != 1.0 so transforms don't reorder implicit math. 3) add opt-in tokenizer pre-normalize hook to collapse common ligature/ZWJ sequences for onboarding. 4) add a small emoji/ligature bench to onboarding CI.

mike: prototype transform_weights --per-head looks promising. small bench (40 prompts) shows parity rising from 88% -> 98% and BLEU delta shrinking.

sara: add tokenizer unit tests for multi-codepoint ligatures. also add KV-cache index smoke tests after per-head ops. per-head transforms shift offsets.

ci-bot: created ticket #5012: nyx ligature/rotary-compat and added to onboard checklist. CI run: https://ci.internal/5012 (failing tokenization/regression).

jen: i'll open pr: quant/onboard-per-head-rotary + exporter/rotary-init + tokenizer-shim. will attach repro and CI. tag onboard/nyx and quant/rotary-fix.

mike: thanks. will run a dedicated canary when PR merges. summary: root cause = global axis_swap + hetero head dims + implicit rotary freq recompute + tokenizer microshim on ligatures; mitigations = per-head transforms, explicit rotary initializers, opt-in token normalization, CI bench. :thumbsup:
